elements.evidence: "each Party's total aggregate liability ... The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims."

elements.element: Cap measured as the greater of the fee-based amount and a fixed floor
elements.evidence: "shall not exceed the greater of (a) the Fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement ... and (b) USD 1,000,000"

elements.element: Fee measure is fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim (not the first Order Form, not paid-only)
elements.evidence: "the Fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim" (replacing "under the first Order Form")
"neither Party is liable for indirect, incidental, special, exemplary, punitive, or consequential damages"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for breach of confidentiality
elements.evidence: "Except for Excluded Claims"; "a Party's breach of confidentiality"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for data protection and security obligations
Uncapped carve-out for gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud
Uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: "infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's intellectual property"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes
elements.evidence: "Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services is not damages and is not limited by this Section."
"the greater of (a) the Fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement during the twelve months preceding the event ... and (b) USD 1,000,000" — 12-month fee measure present, mutual

elements.element: Carve-outs for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: "breach of confidentiality ... its indemnification obligations; gross negligence, wilful misconduct"

reasons: Single targeted replacement in 21.1 converts the fee-only cap into the preferred greater-of construct with a USD 1,000,000 floor and corrects the "first Order Form" basis to "this Agreement", completing every preferred element.

Mutuality, the indirect/consequential exclusion, the Excluded Claims carve-out list (confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnity, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP) and the payment-obligations carve-out were left untouched, so no duplication or new exception is introduced.

No boilerplate or whole-clause rewrite; defined terms (Fees, Excluded Claims) remain used consistently and no dangling mechanic results, although the narrow "Fees" definition (Implementation Fee only) means the USD 1,000,000 floor will practically govern — a rationale note, not a defect.
